summary: NaaS Technology Inc. (the Company) filed a Form 6-K reporting its entry into a Share Acquisition Agreement to acquire 100% of China Newlink Holding Limited from Newlink Digital Energy Holding Limited, an affiliate of its controlling shareholder. The aggregate consideration is US$15 million, satisfied by issuing 16 billion Class A ordinary shares (5 million ADSs) at a reference price of $3.00 per ADS. The acquisition is a related-party transaction, not subject to shareholder approval, relying on home country practices. Closing conditions include establishing a WFOE, securing data assets, regulatory approvals, and Audit Committee fairness determination. Watch for regulatory and shareholder scrutiny given related-party nature and share issuance.
